Dear Hiring Committee,

I am writing to express my interest in the Project Manager position within the MeDic program at the Research Institute of the MUHC. I am a biomedical researcher with extensive experience coordinating research projects in academic and healthcare environments.

During my postdoctoral training at the Centre de recherche du CHUM and Université de Montréal, I have collaborated in and coordinated multidisciplinary research projects involving clinicians, researchers, trainees, and external collaborators. My responsibilities include project organization, data analysis, scientific writing, manuscript preparation, and research dissemination. My doctoral research in biomedical engineering focused on cancer biology, experimental design, and longitudinal evaluation of therapeutic responses using animal models. My research experience in preclinical and clinical research provide me with strong familiarity with laboratory workflows, biomedical experiment planning, and translational research environments.

I have experience supporting grant applications, including literature reviews, proposal development, scientific editing, and coordination with research teams. I contributed to a CIHR-funded grant application as a co-investigator and developed a competitively funded research proposal during my doctoral training.

Throughout my academic career, I have managed research deliverables, prepared manuscripts and scientific presentations, coordinated collaborations, and maintained organized documentation of complex projects. I have published multiple peer-reviewed articles and contributed to scientific communication activities across biomedical and public health fields.

I am fluent in French and English and have experience working within collaborative research institutions in Québec. My organizational skills, scientific background, and ability to translate research objectives into practical workflows would allow me to effectively support investigators and research teams.

I am motivated by the opportunity to contribute to the different research projects in cancer biology in the MeDic program. I would welcome the opportunity to support your laboratory’s research activities through effective project coordination, scientific communication, and operational management.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
